verdict.rationale: Algolia ships first-party 'agent skills' (algolia-cli, algolia-mcp, algolia-crawler, algolia-migration) explicitly designed so an AI agent can manage indices, settings, rules, synonyms, analytics and recommendations via natural-language-driven tool calls, backed by a documented and runtime-verified hosted MCP server (mcp.algolia.com) and CLI. This is squarely aimed at AI-native operation rather than just customer-facing conversational search (Agent Studio is a separate end-user feature). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a natural-language command actually completing an operation end-to-end (the MCP probe only reached an auth challenge, not a successful invocation), and no community reports of AI-native CLI/MCP usage in practice.
